doc.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Playing New York
summary: He loves going to New York to get energized.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I’ve been saying this. I said it at the club at the Iridium when I was there. I told the people, get that book, man. Just read it.
Do you like going to New York to play?
Oh yeah, all the time. My wife and I, we’re crazy about New York. Yeah, boy. Go to New York and get energized, come back here and lose it, and then go back.
You’ve got to charge up your batteries to keep up with it.
